artifact.canonical_name: AVTok: 1D Unified Tokenization for Holistic Audio-Video Generation

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30811v1
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The authors propose AVTok, a unified one-dimensional tokenizer for paired audio-video generation.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.finding: AVTok uses a shared encoder-decoder, modality-specific queries, and a unified 1D codebook for audio-video tokenization; the authors evaluate reconstruction plus downstream audio-to-video, video-to-audio, and joint generation.

editorial.why_now_note: This June paper is technically valid but is retained as supporting/Paper Watch material unless Candidate Selection has room.
editorial.rationale: Primary-paper evidence is valid but lower priority than stronger June themes.
